evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 3.3 ppm after successful purge and low-oxygen ramp.
Oxygen rose progressively through 6.3 and 10.7 ppm to 17.1 ppm during growth.
Oxygen continued rising through 22.2 and 26.2 ppm to 33.2 ppm despite unchanged growth setpoints.
Temperature 750.5 °C, heater power 45.4%, argon 99.2 sccm, and pressure 760.1 Torr remain stable; these readings do not explain the sustained oxygen increase.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and gas-supply purity/leak checks are needed to distinguish air ingress, including a possible seal leak, from contamination or oxygen-sensor error. Sample characterization is not yet available.
